svg.title: A request gives way to an extended wait
svg.desc: Send one request toward the board, then leave a long empty time band. Waiting is the visible state; no implied reply or rejection should fill it.

**Frame:** Right column continues. A short request leaves `PHASEONE10841` for the board, summarized rather than quoted. Below it, the column goes almost empty: a thin band of dead time marked only by a small clock.

**Action:** The agent asks whether any run has Hugging Face credentials, and the question sits.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> THE REQUEST IS PICKED UP TWENTY-FIVE HOURS LATER.
